# StreamWriter

A `TextWriter` over any stream, recording the stream's failure where the caller can see it.

```rux
pub struct StreamWriter {
    // private fields
}
```

The same two halves as [`ConsoleWriter`](/docs/api/io/console-writer), over a destination the caller chose: a file, a buffered writer, a pipe.
It is what lets a value describe itself into a stream at all — `Display` writes into a `TextWriter` and a stream
takes bytes, and until something stands between them a value can only be rendered to standard output or into
memory.
Whole runs go out through [`WriteAll`](/docs/api/io/writer#write-all), so a stream that takes a partial write is looped over rather than losing
the rest of a value's text.
The slot must outlive the writer. It is a stored address, so nothing here tracks that.

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>StreamWriter</code></h3>

```rux
pub func StreamWriter(
    sink: Writer,
    failure: *var IoError?
) -> StreamWriter
```

A text writer over `sink`, recording into `failure`.
`sink` is borrowed for the call and kept. The slot is read before every write as well as written on failure,
so a writer built over a slot that already holds a failure writes nothing at all.

| Name      | Type            | Description                                                           |
| --------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sink`    | `Writer`        | where the bytes go                                                    |
| `failure` | `*var IoError?` | where the first stream failure is recorded, `none` until there is one |

**Returns**: a text writer over that stream

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Io/Src/TextBoundary.rux#L142)

## Implements TextWriter

`StreamWriter` conforms to `TextWriter`.

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(
    self: &var StreamWriter,
    bytes: char8[..]
) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes `bytes` to the stream.
Reports `WriterFailure` when the stream refuses, having recorded the original [`IoError`](/docs/api/io/io-error) in the slot. Once a
failure has been recorded every later write is refused without touching the stream, so a value part-way
through rendering does not go on writing into a destination that has already failed.

| Name    | Type        | Description            |
| ------- | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `bytes` | `char8[..]` | the UTF-8 run to write |

**Returns**: success when the stream accepted the whole run

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Io/Src/TextBoundary.rux#L155)
